resource: Retry and reconciliation work for one DUR-03 native one-item logical transaction
allocation_impact: All attempts reuse the same TransactionId and frozen candidate; an unknown outcome is held and never gets a new TransactionId; each pass stays within DFR-DB-PASS-MS (2,000 ms).
boundary_tests: max=3: three retry/reconciliation work units accepted
max+1=4: a fourth work unit is rejected
consumers: apps/game-server/src/durability/item_mint.rs (stage C runtime MINT: the logical transaction is a durable reservation keyed by the full cause tuple; each commit attempt or reconciliation pass first charges one unit to it with a committed conditional UPDATE, across re-freezes, restarts and concurrent holders; the fourth is rejected before the pass's work)
apps/game-server/src/durability/house_interior_audit.rs and house_interior.rs (HOUSE-RUNTIME-1a: closed one-item House place/take/tile-move, same-transaction custody/receipt/event)
notes: D51, decision §3.3: a policy value, not a measurement. Stage C must re-decide it once real PostgreSQL reconciliation exists and prove max/max+1 across a restart. Registered by OTV2-20260928-dur03-b4-binding-513.
